behavior_constraints: Binary builds with `go build -o kvstore ./cmd/kvstore` from /app
Reads commands from stdin one per line, writes results to stdout
PUT key value -> OK <seqnum> (value is trimmed remainder after key)
SCAN start end [--prefix p] [--limit N] [--reverse] -> key\tvalue lines, no tombstoned keys
FLUSH -> OK and forces MemTable to SSTable
COMPACT -> OK and triggers full compaction across all levels
entities.summary: Build from scratch a Go LSM-Tree key-value engine with WAL, MemTable, SSTables, MVCC snapshots, optimistic transactions, batch writes, and a stdin/stdout CLI.

instruction_head:
I need a high-performance embedded key-value storage engine built in Go from scratch, using an LSM-Tree (Log-Structured Merge-Tree) architecture with full MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) support, optimistic transactions, and advanced query capabilities. The engine must be accessible through a command-line interface that reads commands from stdin (one per line) and writes results to stdout.
